headline: Chainflip confirms a $12 million vault hack and offers the attacker a 10% bounty

scenes.vo: Cross-chain swap protocol Chainflip now says about twelve million dollars was stolen from its vaults. Here's what changed.

The first reports said under five million. Chainflip's own notice lists about one hundred twenty three Bitcoin, five hundred twenty Ether, and four million in stablecoins, taken on November twenty first.
Here's why traders are watching it. Chainflip says a signing key was exposed, not a code bug. Its services are paused, and its flip token fell about forty three percent in a day.
Here's what happens next. Chainflip offered the attacker a ten percent bounty to return the rest by Monday, eighteen thirty eight UTC. Watch those return wallets.
